character.name:
Althea Niel H. Capule (The Supporter)
Visual Description: A young, petite female hunter with long, vibrant pink hair. She has large, expressive eyes and a nervous but hopeful smile.

Outfit: A modified, high-tech Baro’t Saya in soft lavender and blue, featuring neon cyan glow-strips along the embroidery.

Equipment: A tall, gnarled wooden staff strapped to her back, tipped with a glowing crystal that pulses with energy.

Combat Stance: Holds her staff forward with both hands; glowing cyan runes appear in the air when she casts [Heal] or [Haste].
